mira: Quick note from todays spike  loader API for safetensors shards. Two-mode idea: index-first vs stream-first, with auto policy.
jon: Index-first is great for warmup but adds manifest fetch. Need fallback to stream on manifest errors.
lee: Suggest tiny header hint (<=512B) with aggregate CRC + offset seeds to enable progressive warmup when manifest absent.
jon: Agree but require a finalize marker (.final) or content-addressed upload before trusting hints. Otherwise risk partial reads.
mira: API sketch: Loader.open(uri, mode=auto) -> {handle, warmup_plan}. WarmupPlan=list of small ranges. Telemetry: warmup.path and warmup.fallback.
infra-bot: ran spike tests on s3-emulator. branch spike/mini-loader. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/2001
mira: Next: short RFC draft with hint schema (<=512B), finalize requirement, and migration CLI. Will post tomorrow.
